name: soft
description: Barely there: a gentle curve and a little highlight cleanup, for footage that already looks right and only wants finishing.

name: punchy
description: More contrast and vibrance than crisp, highlights still protected. For sunny days and bright colours that should read from across the room.

name: cold
description: Cooler overall with lifted, blue-leaning shadows: the storm-day look, overcast and quiet rather than warmed up.
